Nvidia Stock Rally Cools, Impacting Short Sellers and Market Futures

Nvidia's stock rally, which had previously boosted the Nasdaq-100 with only six stocks falling during its surge, began to cool, leading to a dip in Wall Street futures and European stocks. This cooling trend followed a significant rally fueled by Nvidia, causing massive losses for short sellers and leveraged funds. The market is now assessing the implications of Nvidia's performance on broader tech stocks.
